title: slugify leaves double dashes in URLs
body:
Product URLs look broken for names with punctuation.

`slugify("Blue T-Shirt (Large)")` returns `blue-t-shirt--large` but it should be `blue-t-shirt-large`. Any run of spaces or symbols should become a single dash.

title: truncate returns text longer than the limit
body: We use `truncate` to fit product titles into a 10-character label, but `truncate("Wireless headphones", 10)` gives `Wireless h...`, which is 13 characters. The result including the `...` should never be longer than the limit.

title: Prices with single-digit cents display wrong
body: The checkout page shows `$12.5` for an item that costs $12.05. `format_price(1205)` should return `$12.05`. Whole-dollar prices are wrong too: `format_price(100)` gives `$1.0` instead of `$1.00`.

title: Discount over 100% makes the price negative
body: A misconfigured promotion gave a 150% discount and the cart showed a negative total. `apply_discount(1000, 150)` returns `-500`. A price should never go below 0.

title: Adding the same item twice loses the first quantity
body:
Steps:
1. `cart.add("apple", 50, quantity=2)`
2. `cart.add("apple", 50, quantity=3)`

Expected 5 apples in the cart, but there are only 3.

title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly 10 items
body: The docs say carts with 10 items or more get 10% off. A cart with exactly 10 pens at $1.00 totals $10.00 instead of $9.00. It works with 11 items.

title: Saturday is treated as a working day
body: Orders placed on Friday with 1-day delivery are promised for Saturday, but the warehouse is closed at weekends. `is_weekend(date(2026, 10, 31))` returns False even though Oct 31 2026 is a Saturday.

title: median is wrong for an even number of values
body: `median([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns 3. For an even count it should be the mean of the two middle values, so 2.5.
